reviewed.name: EYE MK.2 professional hand-held compass
reviewed.rationale: The compass already has a bounded Baseline role in frozen Admiral and pinned SPT 4.1.3 Jaeger also provides it as an unlimited direct offer. Relationship standing must not reclassify or duplicate an existing Baseline convenience offer merely to make loyalty progression more visible.

reviewed.name: Vortex Ranger 1500 rangefinder
reviewed.rationale: The handheld rangefinder fits Admiral's reconnaissance theme, but pinned SPT 4.1.3 Jaeger already exposes it with unlimited direct stock. A Relationship copy would be thematic duplication, not meaningful progression.

reviewed.name: Paracord
reviewed.rationale: Paracord already has a bounded frozen Admiral Baseline offer, is not consumed by its extract utility, and pinned Jaeger consumes twelve units in a high-value barter. Relationship materialization would therefore duplicate Admiral's own convenience layer while further weakening barter scarcity.

conclusion.finding: The strongest obvious navigation/observation special-slot candidates are either already represented by frozen Admiral Baseline stock or are unlimited vanilla offers. Relationship progression should not cannibalize Baseline semantics, duplicate Jaeger, or manufacture standing value from scarcity bypass.
